Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The test checks operation names in the CLI refusal line. INFO logging remains enabled in the child process. The checks for exit status and no output files remain in place. The decision record explains the change.

Results locally against upstream/main `211105042b817a5b32fdf2c971d42e6d968297c6`:

- Trial merge: already up to date; no conflicts.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. All nine tests in `default_machine_missing` passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Heavy plan: no reached heavy tests.

Extra suites run: none required. The diff changes no fixtures, goldens, import code, or UI code.

Mutations: not run. This PR changes a test and its decision record. It changes no production code, posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, or stock simulation. No goldens moved.

Requested before merge: none.

The full batch and release gates did not run. No GUI checks ran. Cargo reported the existing unused workspace dependency `truck-polymesh`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
